# voipms_callbacks (Data Source)

Lists callbacks (`getCallbacks`).


## Example Usage

```terraform
data "voipms_callbacks" "all" {}
```


<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `callbacks` (Attributes List) Callbacks on this account. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--callbacks))
- `id` (String) Placeholder identifier (`callbacks`).

<a id="nestedatt--callbacks"></a>
### Nested Schema for `callbacks`

Read-Only:

- `callerid_number` (String) Caller ID presented to the callback number.
- `delay_before` (Number) Delay before prompt, in seconds.
- `description` (String) Description.
- `digit_timeout` (Number) Digit timeout in seconds.
- `id` (String) Callback id.
- `number` (String) Callback destination number.
- `response_timeout` (Number) Response timeout in seconds.
